_instructions: id must follow '{countryCodeLower}:{level}:{sourceCode}' — sourceCode will be the official constituency number, e.g. '01-Dhaka-1' becomes 'bd:constituency:01'.
level is always 'constituency' (a non-hierarchical level, so parentId stays null).
composedOf lists the upazila region ids that make up the constituency. Every id must exist in regions.json.
names must include at least the default locale 'en'; add 'bn' too.
Source to fill from later: Election Commission / https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Jatiya_Sangsad — MUST be verified by a human.
